skills.name: ai-review-and-fix
skills.purpose: AI review and auto-fix workflow. Ensures Copilot review, runs an independent Claude Code review, cross-checks for similar/missed issue patterns, then delivers fixes as a separate follow-up PR stacked on the reviewed PR. Project-level replacement for the user-level /fix-review (renamed to avoid skill-name collision). Args: [PR_NUMBER] [--skip-copilot] [--no-crosscheck].

skills.name: feature-design
skills.purpose: Create design documents for Revit add-in features from requirement specifications. Used to design a feature, create a design document, investigate existing implementations, and determine module assignments. Does NOT generate implementation code; humans review the output.

skills.name: impact-analysis
skills.purpose: Analyze the diff of a PR to determine impact scope, then post a checklist and detail report as a PR comment (and optionally save the report to a file). PR number can be auto-resolved from the current branch. Args: [PR_NUMBER] [--no-post] [--depth 1|2|3|auto] [--output <path>].

skills.name: implementation
skills.purpose: Implement and test Revit add-in features based on requirement and design documents. Used to write code, create tests, and perform implementation self-review. Follows strict architecture constraints, MVVM patterns, DI rules, and test conventions.

skills.name: sonarqube-auto-fix
skills.purpose: Fetch SonarQube issues for a PR (server https://sonar.arent3d.com, ArentInc/architecture_routing), fix genuine issues, resolve false-positives via refactoring or NOSONAR, then deliver fixes as a follow-up PR. Used when the SonarQube Quality Gate fails or to clean up static-analysis findings. Args: <PR_NUMBER> [--dry-run] [--direct-push] [--pre-check].

skills.name: spec-writer
skills.purpose: Create internal program specification documents and external (user-facing) specification documents for Revit add-in commands or feature groups. Used to write, update, or regenerate spec documents. Args: [internal|external|both] [--group <group-name>] [--update]. (Currently untracked in git.)

build_test_commands.build: dotnet build -c "Debug 2023"  (also: dotnet build -c "Release 2023"; output to bin/Debug|Release/2023/, post-build copies .addin to %ProgramData%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\{VERSION})
build_test_commands.format: dotnet format  (enforced via .github/workflows/format.yml; manual workflow_dispatch trigger; uses ArchitectureRouting.slnx)
build_test_commands.test: Unit tests in Tests/ (NSubstitute mocking); integration tests in Arent3d.Architecture.Routing.RevitTest/ require a running Revit; automated runs via .github/workflows/autotest.yml on self-hosted runners (PR-comment / manual workflow_dispatch triggers)
